info.name: OffsetFX
info.comment: A filter effect that offsets the position of an input source.

description.p: This filter offsets the input image relative to its current position in the image space by the specified vector of (XOffset,YOffset).

If the VectorFilter.PrimitiveUnits of the filter is BOUNDING_BOX, the offsets are fractions of the bounding box. By default the X offset is scaled by the bounding box width and the Y offset by its height, as per the SVG standard. If the VectorFilter.AspectRatio is NONE, both offsets are scaled by the normalised diagonal of the bounding box, which is the same formula used by a scaled stroke width. The direction of the offset is then the same for any shape, which suits drop shadows.

action.name: Draw
action.comment: Draws object graphics to drawable areas.
action.prototype: ERR acDraw(*Object, DOUBLE X, DOUBLE Y, DOUBLE Width, DOUBLE Height)

input.param: The X position of the region to be drawn.
The Y position of the region to be drawn.
The width of the region to be drawn.
The height of the region to be drawn.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Returns an SVG compliant XML string that describes the effect.

field.name: XOffset
field.comment: The delta X coordinate for the input graphic.

description.p: The (XOffset, YOffset) field values define the offset of the input source within the target clipping area. The value is measured in the units of the filter's VectorFilter.PrimitiveUnits.

field.name: YOffset
field.comment: The delta Y coordinate for the input graphic.

description.p: The (XOffset, YOffset) field values define the offset of the input source within the target clipping area. The value is measured in the units of the filter's VectorFilter.PrimitiveUnits.
